title: Empirical sample scheduler and statistical anchoring for FP8 enablement on Hopper (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Safely enable FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) profiles on Hopper for a subset of models by building a data-driven sampling scheduler and a statistical anchoring calibration pipeline. This ticket focuses on: 1) designing a representative sample scheduler that prioritizes tail-case sequences, long-context prompts, and common customer prompt shapes; 2) constructing 'golden anchors' (fixed prompt set + synthetic perturbations) for continuous drift detection; 3) per-layer variance estimators and a noise model that informs dynamic per-op scaling; 4) a latency-aware hybrid fallback that toggles between FP8 and INT8/FP32 variants based on KL/EMD thresholds and observed micro-batch jitter; and 5) a canary rollout plan tied to telemetry gating and automated rollback.
tasks: Design sampling scheduler: weight sampling by token-length distribution, user-frequency, and failure-mode heuristics
Implement golden anchor generator: curated 250-prompt seed + 4 perturbation families (truncation, hallucination-stress, repetition, metadata-noise)
Build per-layer variance estimator: collect per-op activation histograms during shadow runs and compute robust std/iqr stats
Integrate noise model into calibration service: map variance -> recommended per-layer FP8 scale factors and hysteresis
Add micro-batch jitter injection harness for test clusters to measure sensitivity to runtime scheduling
Define telemetry probes: KL divergence to FP32 baseline, token-level perplexity delta, tail-latency P99 change, and calibration drift score
Create canary config: 1% QPS dark launch, 0.1% live traffic for golden anchors, progressive 1/3/10/30 rollout with rollback gates
Alerting and runbook: automatic pause + revert if KL>0.04 AND tail-latency P99 increases >10% over baseline for 1h
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end pipeline produces per-layer scale recommendations with coverage >= 95% for sampled anchors
KL divergence between FP8 outputs and FP32 baseline < 0.03 on the golden anchor set and validation corpus
No customer-facing latency regression above 5% P99 during 24h canary at 10% traffic
Automated rollback trigger validated in staging against injected noise and micro-batch jitter scenarios
Runbook and dashboard published in Console (link in comments) and sign-off from Reliability and Applied ML
